sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Ashwani Kumar Mishra,J.
Hon'ble Syed Aftab Husain Rizvi,J.
Against the order impugned, petitioner has the remedy of preferring appeal under Section 70 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, which has not been availed.
In such circumstances, we are not inclined to entertain the writ petition.
Leaving it open for the petitioner to pursue the statutory alternative remedy against the order impugned, this writ petition is consigned to records.
